summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal rulings and significant business developments, particularly in the retail and FMCG sectors, impacting market dynamics.

bullets.text: Allahabad High Court upholds a juvenile's murder conviction, stating punishment is essential, leaving sentencing to the Juvenile Justice Board.
Supreme Court rules DVC's Sinking Fund contribution and depreciation can be included in electricity tariffs, reaffirming binding precedent under Article 141.
ITC's Q2 profit is expected to fall nearly 30% YoY due to an 8% decline in cigarette volumes amid tax hikes.
Reliance Consumer expands its FMCG portfolio with the launch of Joyland Dairy Drinks, enhancing its market offerings.
Centre exempts Isobgul (Psyllium Seeds) from GST effective 1 November 2026, under notifications dated 27 October 2026.
